label: Extra lesson
title: Past continuous
intro: Was / were + -ing: what were you doing? Today’s grammar and words, and what we learnt before.
intro_uz: Was / were + -ing: nima qilayotgan edingiz? Bugungi grammatika, so’zlar va oldingi mavzular.
message: Homework · Past continuous. Do it before the next lesson. Rasmga oling yoki chop eting.

parts.title: Was or were?
items: I {was|were} reading a book at nine o’clock.
{Was|Were} the children playing in the garden?
Were you working yesterday? — Yes, I {was|were}.

parts.title: Write the verb
items: Aziz and Bobur ___ (play) football after school.
I ___ (write) a letter at ten o’clock.
We ___ (not / watch) TV. We were talking.

parts.title: Negatives and questions
items: You were talking on the phone.

parts.title: Put the words in order
items: the bus / We / waiting for / were

parts.title: What we learnt before
items: Look! The baby {is sleeping|was sleeping} now.
The cat is {under|between} the bed. (karavot tagida)
There {is|are} two parks in my town.

items.prompt: Write 6 sentences: what were you doing yesterday at 7:00, 9:00, 12:00, 15:00, 18:00 and 21:00?
items.hint: Example: At seven o’clock I was having breakfast. At nine o’clock I was travelling to work.
